description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeAllowedLanguageAPI of the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It tests API methods such as getAll, create, delete, and their validation rules in the context of employee language preferences.

classes.name: EmployeeAllowedLanguageAPITest
classes.description: Test suite for the EmployeeAllowedLanguageAPI, extending EndpointTestCase to verify retrieval, creation, deletion, and validation rules of employee language API endpoints.

methods.name: loadFixtures
methods.description: Loads fixture data for testing by populating the database with predefined employee language records.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests that the delete operation throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests validation rules for the delete operation, expecting a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests that the create operation throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Tests validation rules for create operation, expecting a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all employee allowed languages, verifying the returned data and metadata for different employee numbers.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validates the getAll method's validation rules: checks user permissions and employee number validity.
